newsitem.title: UK: U-Freight America names Los Angeles manager.
newsitem.headline: U-Freight America names Los Angeles manager.

text.p: U-Freight America said it has appointed Kevin Tousant as its new Los Angeles station manager.

He was formerly based at the company's San Francisco corporate headquarters, where he was manager of a special project involving a multinational telecommunications client, the company said in a statement issued here.
U-Freight America said it has also promoted Anna Lok to sales manager from office manager at the Los Angeles office.
Tousant said that 85 percent of the company's Los Angeles business comprised air freight and 15 percent sea freight.

U-Freight America, whose network covers Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, New York, San Francisco and Toronto, is part of an international U-Freight forwarding franchise alliance. --Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel +44 171 542 7706; fax +5017
